meta.title: Ask Me Why
meta.instructions: Read the strange story. Type yes or no questions and tap Ask. When you know what happened, type it and tap Solve.

qa_setups: A man walks into a bar and asks for a glass of water. The bartender pulls out a gun and points it at him. The man says ’Thank you’ and leaves. Why?

Priya sets a loud kitchen alarm for five minutes after her bedside one. Every morning she races to stop it before it sounds. The night her power failed, she chose to sleep at a friend’s house instead.
qa_reveals: The man had hiccups and hoped water would cure them. The bartender realised this and pointed a gun at him to frighten him. The shock cured his hiccups, so he no longer needed the water. He thanked the bartender and left.

Priya lives alone after collapsing once, undetected for hours. Her neighbour listens each morning: if Priya is well she reaches the kitchen and stops the second alarm before it sounds; if it rings on, she may be unable to get up and needs help. Without power the safeguard could fail, so she stayed with a friend.
